results.question: give me all datasets that deal specifically with social conflicts
results.explanation: The user is looking for datasets that involve social conflicts.
results.sql:
SELECT tier_base.*, ut.uncertain_level, ut.uncertain_reasons
FROM (
SELECT d.id, d.name, d.accession_id, d.bids_version, d.dataset_type, d.source_type, d.remote_url, d.validation_status, d.authors, d.institutions, d.description_text, COUNT(DISTINCT o.subject) AS subject_count FROM bids_datasets AS d LEFT JOIN bids_objects AS o ON o.dataset_id = d.id AND NOT o.subject IS NULL WHERE ((d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'social & conflicts')) OR (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'social & conflicts') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'social & conflicts'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'conflicts')))) GROUP BY d.id
) AS tier_base
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT us.u0 AS uncertain_level, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS('; ', CASE WHEN us.u0 = 1 AND us.p0 THEN 'found only in a paper the dataset names' WHEN us.u0 = 1 THEN 'matches only part of the search; missing: social' END), '') AS uncertain_reasons,
         (CASE WHEN us.u0 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_unsure, (us.u0 <= 1) AS has_evidence
  FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'social & conflicts')) THEN 0 WHEN (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'social & conflicts') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'social & conflicts'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'conflicts'))) THEN 1 ELSE 9 END AS u0,
      ((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'social & conflicts') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'social & conflicts'))) AS p0
    FROM bids_datasets AS d WHERE d.id = tier_base.id
  ) AS us
) AS ut
WHERE ut.uncertain_level < 9 AND ut.n_unsure <= 1 AND ut.has_evidence

) AS tier_base

  SELECT GREATEST(us.u0, us.u1) AS uncertain_level, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS('; ', CASE WHEN us.u0 = 1 AND us.p0 THEN 'found only in a paper the dataset names' WHEN us.u0 = 1 THEN 'matches only part of the search; missing: experimentally' END, CASE WHEN us.u1 = 1 THEN 'diagnosis not recorded' WHEN us.u1 = 2 THEN 'diagnosis not recorded' END), '') AS uncertain_reasons,
